comment: The contract cases of the generator (binding G-5): each case calls its member once with the arguments that it names by their parameter names, each json_value written as {kind, value}. A case without raises succeeds; raises names the kind of the failure. The rules themselves are tested by the shared fixtures of tests/fixtures.

compile_form.note: a form with one text field compiles.
a field map of a file of options.files is composed.
a reference to a file that options.files does not hold.
a file without the properties that the reference reads.
two files that reference each other.
a reference that is no text.
a patch that is no object.
a patch that names a path below a value that is no object.
a patch that removes a member that the file does not hold.
a label with an unpaired surrogate.
a specification that is no object.

build_outline.note: an outline of no node is empty.

render_outline_view.note: the outline view of no field.
a language that the interface text does not hold.

render_data_panel.note: the data panel of one member.
a language that the interface text does not hold.

resolve_action.note: the action undo names no path.
an input without an action resolves to none.

initial_view.note: the initial view has no collapsed row.

collapsible_rows.note: no node has no collapsible row.

set_all_expanded_view.note: expanding no node collapses no row.

empty_history.note: the empty history has no entry.

sequence_row_key.note: a sequence is padded to 13 digits.
a sequence that is no decimal digits.

create_row_key.note: a row key of 13 hexadecimal digits; the failure of the random source cannot be given by a case.
